# freecenter_vm (Data Source)

Look up a virtual machine or template by name on a host (by host_id or host_name), e.g. a template to clone with clone_from.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `host_id` (String)
- `host_name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `datastores` (List of String)
- `firmware` (String)
- `guest_id` (String)
- `id` (String) <host_id>/<vm_id>: usable as clone_from and vm_id.
- `ip_address` (String)
- `memory_mb` (Number)
- `networks` (List of String) Port group of each network adapter, in order.
- `num_cpus` (Number)
- `power_state` (String) poweredOn, poweredOff or suspended.
- `template` (Boolean)
- `uuid` (String)
- `vm_id` (String) Id of the VM on its host.
